capabilities: Reset font size to a user-configurable default
Optionally reset the global window zoom level along with font size
Trigger the reset from a sidebar ribbon button
Trigger the reset from the command palette or a bound hotkey
extras: The README suggests Cmd+Shift+0 (Ctrl+Shift+0 on Windows) as a keybinding; screenshots illustrate the sidebar button, command palette, and hotkey triggers.
intentEvidence: you can also do this manually from Settings > Appearance > Font Size, but this is faster
motivation: The author kept getting stuck zoomed in on notes with no quick way to get the text back to normal size, so wrote this small plugin to fix it.
problem: After accidentally zooming in with the mouse wheel, trackpad, or keyboard, cmd/ctrl+0 and restarting Obsidian don't restore the text size, so users have to change the setting manually.
summary: Font size reset utility that adds a ribbon button and command to restore the font size (and optionally window zoom) to a configurable default.
